summary: This week in AI news, significant developments include AWS embedding vibe-coding tool Superblocks, OpenAI's influencer trip sparking backlash, and Apple overhauling Siri. Other notable stories cover AI deployment, robotics, and policy changes.
insight: The increasing integration of AI into various industries and aspects of life is raising concerns about safety, ethics, and governance, prompting calls for the industry to 'pace' itself and consider the implications of rapid AI development.
highlights: AWS partners with Superblocks to embed vibe-coding tools into private clouds.
OpenAI faces criticism for its first luxury influencer trip.
Apple's Siri overhaul aims to make it a more competent assistant.

articles.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
articles.description: AWS now allows vibe coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step towards decoupling apps from models.

articles.description: OpenAI’s first-ever influencer brand trip is sparking online backlash as tensions over the use of AI continue.
